changelog: Added U.S. Safe States monitoring: successful U.S. logins from states not on the configured Safe States list can now be flagged as suspicious and sent to Google Chat
Added optional cellular/wireless ISP suppression for Safe States monitoring using the existing wireless-provider exclusion list
Added a State Monitoring activation cutoff so existing historical login rows are not retroactively flagged when the feature is first enabled
Improved wireless-provider list handling so ISP names containing commas are preserved correctly
Preserved existing Script Properties during guided install/repair so saved settings such as the Google Chat webhook are not erased
Improved guided-install diagnostics, trigger health checks, and automatic retry of failed geolocation lookups
Preserved the Impossible Travel null-island protection for missing or invalid geolocation data
Updated the Live Map to use the key-free OpenStreetMap basemap so the map no longer displays API KEY REQUIRED tiles
